selection_method: random.Random(20261024 + int(source_id)).sample(range(17),3) on the fixed 0.25-second grid, 0.8-second windows, Python 3.11; selection was performed without inspecting acoustic outcomes and explicit offsets are authoritative
success: Faithfully reproduce all PR69 baseline source hashes, method counts, per-dog source results, and 500 constructed rows for T0; then quantify training-excerpt-driven changes in identical evaluation mixtures under T1/T2/T3.
falsifiers: Any original baseline/manifest/training source hash mismatch
Any training WAV absent, malformed, invalid window, or low peak below frozen excerpt validity threshold
Any evaluation mixture or original method/threshold change
Any PR69 T0 per-source or aggregate mismatch
Any source ID overlap or reporting of 125 triples as independent WAVs
absolute_floor: No changed originals, no hidden case selection, no private audio, no model training beyond recomputing four fixed prototypes, no natural onset/physical identity claim.
cost_ceiling: $0; <=12 minutes public CI; <=2,000 constructed evaluations across four training arms; one frozen random selection and no retry.
case_selection: All 125 preexisting PR69 source triples and four preexisting active-slot schedules; repeated source IDs acknowledged; development diagnostic, not prospective scientific confirmation.
interpretation_limits: A change under alternate training excerpts only establishes training-excerpt sensitivity, not whether a dog/csaw is present in the selected training interval.
Clip-level labels cannot validate each 0.8s training or evaluation excerpt.
All evaluation sources and their prior outcomes are already exposed; these are DEV cases.
Training offsets may coincide with peak-RMS excerpts by chance; do not reroll.
